# Browser renderer

Three.js 0.180.0, retrieved from its npm distribution. Included matching files:

- `build/three.module.min.js` (stored as `three.module.js`) and `build/three.core.min.js`
- `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `examples/jsm/loaders/STLLoader.js`
- `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`

The browser import map resolves the bare `three` import locally. The upstream MIT license is included in `three/LICENSE`. No third-party CDN is used at runtime.
